scope: Feed actions resumed after successful authentication
assertions: like resumes toward the originally requested state without inverting an already-satisfied authenticated state
post and comment reports retain the exact target
composer opening resumes once; comment continuation retains its exact submitted text
report-comment success is published only after transport success
five simultaneous report confirmations remain pending until individually consumed

cleanup.mode: no remote fixtures or backend mutation used

limitations: This focal evidence is deterministic contract, compilation and iOS Simulator build evidence; final integrated platform certification remains assigned to GitHub Actions.
